children: a leading provider of architectural building products and services, as well as high-performance coated materials used in a variety of applications, today announced the company will report its fiscal 2027 second quarter results on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, before the market opens. The Company will also host a conference call at 8:00 a.m. CT that day.
Access to the live webcast will be available at
. For those unable to listen to the live webcast, a replay and transcript will be available shortly following the call.

Apogee Enterprises, Inc. (Nasdaq: APOG) is a leading provider of architectural building products and services, as well as high-performance coated materials used in a variety of applications. Headquartered in Minneapolis, MN, our portfolio of industry-leading products and services includes architectural glass, windows, curtainwall, storefront and entrance systems, integrated project management and installation services, and high-performance coatings that provide protection, innovative design, and enhanced performance.
